propositions: Read-only derivations over durable ticket event store must correctly compute attempts_per_ticket by counting distinct claim sessions from raw STATUS events with open→in_progress edges.
First-pass verification rate metric must filter closed tickets never reopened by checking for absent last_reopened_at terminal value in compiled state.
Rework-within-days metrics must identify closed→open→closed STATUS edges within time windows (7 and 30 days) by reading raw timestamped events.
Revert-recovery metric must count tickets whose reverts[] contains substantive reversions (STATUS or COMMITS target types) while excluding comment/link reverts.
Reopen-recovery metric must count all tickets with at least one closed→open STATUS edge by scanning raw event files.
Compaction-retired events must be included in all raw event scans via is_active_event filtering and RETIRED_SUFFIX handling, and empty ranges must return None while measured-zero results return 0.
